objects.name: The Warm Wall
objects.vInscr: Bones warm to the touch. Lean on them, and the warmth spreads into you.

objects.name: Chalked Waystone
objects.vInscr: Kindled by pilgrims. Touch it, and every lit waystone on the Hide knows your step.

landmarks.name: The Hand That Was Kept
landmarks.inscription: It blessed the first war and was cut off for it. They caged it rather than bury it, lest the earth be blessed as well.

landmarks.name: The Saint of the Many
landmarks.inscription: She asked that no one be buried alone. They came to her by the thousand, and she has not been alone since.

lights.source: shaft (cold light through vault cracks, pulses)
